hypothesis.statement: The apparent source-level junction matching law is a mixture of degree-conditioned laws. Junction degree is an omitted condition in the current grammar representation.
hypothesis.reason: The frozen null generator preserves (center kind, degree) while the grammar context omits degree.
hypothesis.falsification: If the same junction degree supports both strict matching and strict reversal across independent sources, degree alone is insufficient.

measurement.endpoint_centers: retained in raw compiler output but excluded from primary degree-law analysis
measurement.null_contract: unchanged; arm tokens shuffle only among centers of identical kind and degree within each observation
measurement.strict_match: observed matching accuracy > every one of 64 source-local null matching accuracies
measurement.strict_reverse: observed matching accuracy < every one of 64 source-local null matching accuracies

sequential_custody.step1: Run train lane only and freeze the degree-specific discovery catalogue before opening holdout or control degree outcomes.
sequential_custody.step2: Validate the frozen train degree catalogue on holdout.
sequential_custody.provenance: No provenance/object-type fields enter degree discovery, validation, or confirmation.

train_discovery.degree_eligibility: degree must have >= 10 eligible train sources for at least one arm-state context
classification: MATCH_ONLY if >=5 strict-match source-degree cells and 0 strict reversals
REVERSE_ONLY if >=5 strict-reverse source-degree cells and 0 strict matches
MIXED if >=1 strict match and >=1 strict reversal
train_discovery.candidate_laws: Only MATCH_ONLY or REVERSE_ONLY degree/context pairs enter the frozen train catalogue.

validation.pass_rule: Among decided cells (strict match + strict reverse), >=90% reproduce the train-discovered direction and at least 5 reproduce it.
validation.contradiction_rule: Any opposite strict state is retained and counted; no candidate is silently dropped.

degree_sufficiency_verdict.SUPPORTED: Every train-admitted degree law passes both holdout validation and control confirmation, and no tested degree with >=10 eligible sources is MIXED in either holdout or control.
degree_sufficiency_verdict.PARTIAL: At least one train-admitted degree law validates/confirms, but another degree is MIXED or fails.
degree_sufficiency_verdict.REJECTED: No train-admitted degree law survives both holdout and control, or the dominant train degree is MIXED in holdout/control.
